hero.headlineMain: Launch a token for your community.
headlineMainLines: Launch a token for your community.
hero.headlineAccent: 10% goes to your people, not to whales.
hero.sub: No code, no crypto skills. A phone or a browser is enough: create a wallet in 30 seconds and try it on the testnet.
hero.pitchLine: A blockchain for ordinary people: your own token, club NFT cards and raising money for an idea — no code.
hero.testnetBadge: Public testnet is live. Not mainnet yet.

stages.label: A wallet in 30 seconds
stages.sub: Your keys stay on your phone or in your browser.

stages.label: Your token, priced from the first trade
stages.sub: Pick a name and a ticker. The bonding curve does the pricing.

stages.label: 10% to your people
stages.sub: Every new token sends 10% of its supply to its own community pool.

community.title: 10% of every new token goes to your people
community.lead: Built into the protocol, not promised in a post: every standard launch sends 10% of its supply to that token's own community pool. It is never mixed with network fees.
community.statLabel: of every new token's supply goes to its community pool
community.statNote: The pool belongs to the people who take part in that token — not to the network and not to the creator.
community.footnote: Network fees are split separately: {{community}}% to the community pool, {{validators}}% to validators.

build.title: No-code builder
build.lead: Real wizards already live on the public testnet. Launch a token or NFT, deploy escrow or crowdfunding, describe a contract in plain words, or open Lavka — nothing to install or compile.

cards.title: Launch a token
cards.body: Name, ticker, image and supply. Pay the launch fee and the token goes live on its bonding curve.

cards.title: Mint an NFT collection
cards.body: Club or membership cards as NFTs — upload or generate an image in the browser.

cards.title: Deploy an escrow
cards.body: Sample escrow template on the contracts page: lock funds until a condition or deadline.

cards.title: Start crowdfunding
cards.body: Sample crowdfund template: set a goal and raise in PPL or a test stablecoin.

cards.title: Describe a smart contract in plain words
cards.body: We parameterize a reviewed OpenZeppelin template. You see the Solidity before you sign.

cards.title: Lavka merchant tools
cards.body: Loyalty passes and merchant escrow for local shops — no custom code.

fair.title: The same rules for every community
fair.lead: Three rules are built into the protocol, not promised in a post.

tiles.title: of every new token goes to that token's community pool
tiles.body: Not to the network, not to the creator. The token's own pool, shared with the people who take part.

tiles.title: before a creator's share is fully unlocked
tiles.body: The creator's allocation vests linearly over 180 days, so there is no dump on day one.

tiles.title: of network fees are burned — people get them instead
tiles.body: Every fee is split between validators, the community pool, the treasury, liquidity and Growth. Nothing is destroyed to fake scarcity.

foundersTeaser.title: Founder numbers are still being handed out
foundersTeaser.lead: Claim a number, get a card you can share, and earn a share of the community pool by being early and active.
foundersTeaser.cardHint: Two levels, active people only, 10% up front and the rest over 52 weeks.

agents.title: Agents that work for the group
agents.lead: Agents are first-class users of the network: they pay for what they use and answer to the people they serve.

network.title: Public testnet, right now
network.unavailable: Block height is unavailable right now.
network.note: This is a testnet. The numbers above are real, the tokens are not.

final.title: Testnet is open. Be early, break things, tell us what sucks.
final.body: Every bug report and every confused question goes straight into what we build next.
